about: Tags a state DOT's open data gives OpenStreetMap ways that carry none, by way id, for pavement no name or ref tie can reach (an unnamed way). Each entry is checked against the DOT's own data and is applied only where the way has `when`'s tags, lacks every key it sets that `when` does not pin, and lies wholly inside its box [south, west, north, east]: never over OSM's own value save the one `when` names (a ref or name OSM has wrong or short, as the DOT's data shows), harmless once OSM has it or changes it, and never carried off by an id that a merge stretches onto other pavement. Read by tile.mjs (the road tiles) and names.py (the road-name index). format/names.md.

entries.source: NCDOT State Maintained Roads (NC OneMap open data, gis11.services.ncdot.gov NCDOT_StateMaintainedRoadsQtr): RouteName SR-1544, StreetName 'N Halifax Rd' (RouteID 40401544064 / 40001544064, Nash County 064, project B-5980), from NC-4/NC-48 at 36.06271,-77.81946 to the I-95 exit 145 roundabouts. Every listed way lies within 7 m of the NCDOT line; OSM has them trunk with no name (noname=yes on five), and unsigned_ref SR 1544 on all but the roundabout piece 1314837961, whose 1 km name-index square the others already tie to SR 1544. The box holds all 15 with ~50 m spare and ends before the NC 4 ways east of 44012812 (1390588251, 1390588253), so a merge with them drops the name. The permit prints 'SR-1544 / N Halifax Rd' there (app trip c45df15b)

IDOT (gis1.dot.illinois.gov AdministrativeData/AADT_Historical 2025, Ogle County): the 0.5 mi between IL 64's west and east legs, 42.0477 to 42.0550 at -89.5877, is inventory route 0316, MARKED_NAM S026 (IL 26); IL 64 runs on it. OSM's three ways there are members of both route relations (US:IL 26 and US:IL 64) and carry TIGER's name 'Il Route 26', but ref only 'IL 64'; IL 26's ref'd ways stop at each end (21974749 south, 60180190 north). The permit prints IL-26 through it (app trip 0cb1a4cf)
